goal: Implement sub-project 33.MatrixAlgorithms covering three families: matrix decompositions (LU, QR, full SVD, truncated SVD, randomized SVD), sparse matrix formats (COO, CSR, CSC, multiply, solver), and low-rank neural network weight compression (spectral analysis, SVD compressor, integer 8-bit quantizer, combined compressor). All code follows Genie DNA nine rules, fabric-first pattern, every line documented in plain human language, full behavioral test coverage.

genieRules.rule1_no_typed_model_classes: matrix data stored as double[] flat arrays or immutable records; no classes with business logic inside
genieRules.rule2_no_hardcoded_filters: decomposition parameters come from method arguments, never inlined
genieRules.rule3_operation_result_envelope: every public method returns OperationResult<T>; no exceptions for business errors
genieRules.rule4_base_service: every service class extends BaseService (IMatrixStorage + IMatrixEventLogger injected)
genieRules.rule5_scope_from_context: no tenantId or sessionId parameters; scope comes from injected context
genieRules.rule6_single_dispatcher: MatrixAlgorithmsDispatcher is the single entry point routing all requests
genieRules.rule7_idempotency: write operations accept operationId and check IdempotencyStore before doing work
genieRules.rule8_save_before_dispatch: results saved to IMatrixStorage before StandardEvent is emitted
genieRules.rule9_standard_event: all emitted notifications use the StandardEvent record envelope

documentationRule: every line carries a plain-language comment explaining what it does and why; no abbreviations without full expansion on the same line
testRule: behavioral assertions only; no third-party library parity; in-memory fabric implementations for all dependencies

steps.name: State file + solution registration + build verification
